about: Where each row of docs/research/baggage-claims-content-proposal.csv went on 22 Nov 2026. entered: the rows it became in seed/concepts/baggage-claims/content/<batch>.json (a row's id differs per database, so rows are named by section and title, or by part reference). Not entered: its group in docs/research/baggage-claims-owner-decisions.md (a conflict, b choice, c superseded, d confidence, e website platform) and the reason.
